about: The introitus of the formulary “Epiphany of the Lord” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Behold, the Lord, the Ruler, has come, and in His hand are the kingdom, and power, and sovereignty. O God, give Your judgment to the King, and Your justice to the King’s Son. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Behold, the Lord, the Ruler, has come, and in His hand are the kingdom, and power, and sovereignty.
